description: Implement a server-side PostHog analytics system to replace fragile autocapture tracking. Create a robust event tracking infrastructure that captures key user actions reliably, including signup/signin events that were previously untracked. The system should be safe for self-hosted deployments and work seamlessly in serverless environments.
functional_requirements: Set up a PostHog server singleton with serverless-safe flushing that uses the globalThis pattern similar to the existing Prisma client implementation
Create a fire-and-forget capture helper function that never throws errors and gracefully handles missing PostHog configuration for self-hosted instances
Implement user_signed_up and user_signed_in events with detailed properties including auth provider, email domain, and organization context
Migrate autocapture events to explicit server-side tracking for survey_published, survey_created, and organization_created with relevant metadata
Ensure all tracking is gated on PostHog configuration availability and properly integrated into the existing authentication and survey workflows
